chars.NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan man about 30 with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow corduroy overshirt over a white t-shirt and black jeans
chars.RUDE GUY: a cocky young Moroccan man about 22 with a curly mullet, wearing a shiny red tracksuit jacket, a thin silver chain and sunglasses pushed up on his head
chars.BOUNCER: a huge bald Moroccan bouncer with a thick black beard, wearing a tight black t-shirt with an earpiece and black cargo trousers
chars.FRIENDS: three Moroccan young men in their late twenties in casual night-out clothes: a denim jacket, a green bomber jacket, a striped polo

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a busy karaoke bar in Casablanca at night with neon purple lights: the RUDE GUY sits sprawled on a reserved table and waves the NARRATOR away with a smug face, the NARRATOR stands in front of him, annoyed, palms open. Both faces visible, medium shot, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Karaoke bar at night: the RUDE GUY stares provocatively at the NARRATOR across the room with a cheeky grin, the NARRATOR frowns back holding a soft drink, tension, faces clearly visible, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of the NARRATOR in the karaoke bar, cheeks puffed, lips pursed as if about to spit, eyes narrowed with comic fury, neon lights behind him, flat 2D cartoon illustration, funny expression.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR sits at a bar table holding his chin, thinking hard with a comic worried face, his FRIENDS beside him laughing and holding microphones, karaoke screen glowing in the background, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The FRIENDS sing loudly into microphones on a small karaoke stage, arms around each other, happy and goofy, colorful lights, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Two huge BOUNCERS stand at the entrance door of the karaoke bar with arms crossed, stern faces, neon sign glow above the door (no readable letters), seen from inside, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A huge BOUNCER carries a struggling young customer out of the karaoke bar by the collar, the customer's legs dangling, comic surprised face, other guests staring, flat 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The NARRATOR outside the karaoke bar on a Casablanca street at night, shrugging with a sly half-smile toward the viewer, hands in pockets, city lights behind, flat 2D cartoon illustration.
